asked.item: Is there an endpoint to edit a comment
Is there an endpoint to delete a comment
Is editing or deleting something Blotato can't do

verdict.reason: The Comments page lists exactly three comment endpoints (list, get, post), and none of them edits or deletes a comment, so the closed list answers the question.

steps.text: The Comments API has three endpoints: List Comments (GET /v2/comments), Get Comment (GET /v2/comments/:commentId), and Post Comment (POST /v2/comments).
None of these three endpoints edits or deletes a comment.
quotes: Three endpoints let you list, read, and post comments:
List Comments (GET /v2/comments) returns the comments on your published Instagram and Facebook posts, including audience replies and your own.
Get Comment (GET /v2/comments/:commentId) returns a single comment.
Post Comment (POST /v2/comments) posts a top-level comment, or a reply when you pass parentCommentId, on one of your published Instagram or Facebook posts.

steps.text: To manage Instagram and Facebook comments in the Blotato web app, check the Comments and Messaging Inbox page.
quotes: To manage Instagram and Facebook comments in the Blotato web app, see Comments and Messaging Inbox.
